title: A gym owner's spoken AI Assistant request can go to Sarvam, a company the privacy notice never names
what: When the owner speaks to the AI Assistant, the recording goes first to Sarvam (an Indian speech-to-text company) whenever Sarvam's key is saved on the server; Groq is only the second choice. The privacy notice, in English and Hindi, says spoken requests go to Groq and its list of outside companies has no Sarvam. The spoken request can hold member names, amounts and other gym details. Whether Sarvam's key is saved on the live server could not be checked.
expected: Every outside company that hears a spoken request is named in the privacy notice (both languages) before any recording is sent there, or the recording goes only to the company the notice names.
who: gym owners who speak to the AI Assistant, and the members they name
how_often: every spoken request while Sarvam's key is saved
fix_line: Add Sarvam to the privacy notice (both languages, company table too), or drop Sarvam and use Groq only.

items.reason: The one listed promise (the no-code WhatsApp reply) is only partly kept: it tells a member who started in the app to go back to a page. Already written as FN-A5-server-panel-worker-1-01; no second finding.

Notice: every outside company in this area's code is in the notice except Sarvam for spoken AI Assistant requests (finding 01). Consent: the online join form refuses a send without the adult and health ticks; the page chat contact form carries a consent field (page chat is hidden). Purpose: phone checks keep only keyed hashes for 2 days, the verified number is sealed and emptied once used; feedback and crash reports keep a daily coded address only for limits. Deletion and breach timing: this Worker has no erase or breach step of its own (the gym delete gap is FN-L4-hq-app-05). Children: the join form asks for the adult tick; the friend form has none, but that page is outside this area.

This Worker holds no all-gyms key: every gym read goes through the caller's own sign-in key to the gym server (staff_me, member_pay_me, member_me), so MettleUp staff cannot read gym records through it. Its own small database keeps no member names or numbers; payment rows hold the gym's member id, amount and label only, and payment keys are sealed and never sent to a screen. Log lines never print a number (WhatsApp keeps the last 2 digits). No read log is needed here; the direct-database gap is already FN-A3-notes-claude-1-01.

The daily clean-up matches the notice: crash reports 90 days, spoken-feedback counts 7 days, WhatsApp code rows, waiting checks and friend-form address counts 2 days. Feedback (1 year), demo requests (12 months) and AI use are cleaned by the HQ server; the won demo request gap is FN-L4-hq-app-04. Payment rows, payment connections, the gym's UPI ID and the AI limit rows have no end date; they belong to a live gym, so the gap is only after the gym is deleted (L4.6). Trainer and page questions (400 days) are kept on the gym server, outside this area.

Outside sends from this area: help questions to Anthropic Claude (no gym code, install id or phone model); member-list sample to Google Gemini then Claude, with names, addresses, mobiles, emails and ID numbers hidden again in the Worker; spoken feedback to Groq, not kept; AI Assistant and page chat to Claude with numbers and emails hidden; WhatsApp checks through Meta; payment links to the gym's own payment company with name, mobile and amount only. All match the notice except spoken AI Assistant requests going to Sarvam first (finding 01). The notice's help list also misses the push address and gym key (already FN-A5-phone-lib-core-1-02). No analytics, Health Connect, Google Health or Fitbit in this area.

A member's account delete is not in this area; their help messages stay 1 year as the notice says. A payment company disconnect wipes the gym's sealed keys at once or once no closed link needs them. A gym delete never reaches this Worker's database: besides the feedback, AI use and limit rows named in FN-L4-hq-app-05, the gym's sealed payment keys, every payment request, its UPI ID and payee name, and its two payment switches stay with no end, and the 10-minute check can keep asking the payment company about that gym's open links. Same fault, so FN-L4-hq-app-05 is reused. Nightly backups of this database: none found in this area. A real delete was not run (live write).
